add.title: Φυλακές Κορυδαλλού: Τρανς κρατούμενες θα μεταχθούν για πρώτη φορά στη γυναικεία πτέρυγα (LiFO)
add.summary: LiFO (4 Dec 2021): four trans detainees were ordered transferred to the women's prisons of Korydallou (Athens) by decision of the General Secretary for Crime-Prevention Policy Sofia Nikolaou, after each had petitioned for transfer stating they identify and wish to be treated as women. The four (three Greek, one Bulgarian) had been held at Trikala and Corfu prisons, effectively isolated and treated inconsistently with their self-identified gender. First documented transfer of trans prisoners to a women's facility in Greece; it illustrates that default placement had followed the male facilities and that an on-request transfer route to women's facilities existed.

add.title: LGBTQ rights in Greece — Correctional Facilities section (Wikipedia)
add.summary: Wikipedia's overview of Greek LGBTQ rights records under 'Correctional Facilities' that since 4 December 2021 trans women detainees, upon their request, may be relocated to correctional facilities for women — the policy change matching the Korydallou transfers reported by LiFO the same day. Placement thus starts from the registered sex, with a 4 Dec 2021 decision creating an on-request transfer route for trans women; the article documents no special trans units and no rule covering trans men's placement.
